Step 1: Interception

EVM Provider Proxy

The Chrome extension wraps window.ethereum.request. Before MetaMask opens, the payload is held in a synchronous promise trap.

Step 2: Scoring

Isolation Forest Engine

8 core signals are processed by 100 decision trees. Anomalous drainer patterns isolate in fewer partitions, generating a negative decision boundary score.

Step 3: Enforcement

Pre-Signing Quarantine

If the composite risk score exceeds 70% or an unlimited drainer is detected, a security modal blocks the signing request, shielding tokens from draining.
